interface.longDescription: Create AI fashion portraits from real garment photos. Choose among all 24 styles, review a labeled six-panel direction preview, confirm the direction, then generate six independent images with first-image model review. Explicit single-image requests remain available.
defaultPrompt: Use $threadtruth-studio to inspect my real garment photos, let me choose a style, then prepare a six-panel direction preview before six independent images. Wait for the applicable generation approval; use the single-image branch only if I ask for it.
